reserveReview.rationale: The original composition at block 26107704 remains dated 2026-10-02. A separate metadata review at Ethereum block 26114891 (2026-10-03T22:45:59Z; hash 0x7215bcdfd4a73605d2bafc27738791d6ec1174694cf33890a23fb81811fc7065) reconfirmed asset()=USDf, implementation 0x0d132bee412e6619a4863aeedad97541bfda3f34, cooldownDuration()=0, silo USDf balance=0, and totalAssets()=USDf.balanceOf(vault)-getUnvestedAmount(). Verified withdraw/redeem executes the ERC4626 underlying transfer in the same transaction when cooldown is off, for unrestricted callers, owners and recipients; no strategy realization or offchain settlement is required for the immediate USDf position. The immediate horizon concerns delivery of parent USDf only, not its dollar realization. Restriction/admin/upgrade and future cooldown risks remain separately recorded.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Local underlying identity is fully identified. Upstream parent custody, collateral realization and stressed liquidity remain parent-layer risks; the local percentage is not an end-to-end solvency claim.
